title: A continuous radial retraction onto the unit ball of the Euclidean covector norm
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let F := Covector (Euclid P) n, and let N := covectorEuclideanNorm. Then there is a continuous map ρ : F → F with ρ(0) = 0, N(ρ(a)) ≤ 1 for every a ∈ F, and N(ρ(a) − b) ≤ 2·N(a − b) for all a, b ∈ F with N(b) ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ ρ : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous ρ ∧ ρ 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ a, covectorEuclideanNorm (ρ a) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ a b, covectorEuclideanNorm b ≤ 1 → covectorEuclideanNorm (ρ a - b) ≤ 2 * covectorEuclideanNorm (a - b)
